geometry.note: Real KMC ward polygons (ODbL, datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data). When unavailable the feed falls back to centroid circles sized from each ward's real area — a circle is not a ward outline.

note: Pilot heat-health early warning. Values are MODELLED from forecast weather (WBGT, UTCI, risk score) — not measured. Issued by the HeatShield KMC pilot; verify against IMD bulletins before operational use.
